# Files permitted at the repository root, one per line.
#
# Every entry here is deliberate. The root is where scratch artefacts land,
# because `git add -A` in a worktree you have been working in does not care
# what a file is for, and a one-line addition at the root is invisible in a
# large diff. Four have reached `main` this way:
#
#   .commitmsg/  removed by 490b846c3
#   .commitmsg   re-added by #1881, removed by #1999
#   .pris_v4.log 1364-line cargo transcript, #1951, removed by #1975
#   .body.md     PR body for #2026, removed by the PR that added this file
#
# Each was repaired by adding one more pattern to .gitignore, and each time the
# next one was named outside every pattern. .body.md landed *after* two such
# fixes, hours after both. Enumerating what belongs is the only form of this
# check that does not need to predict the next filename.
#
# To add a root file legitimately: add it here in the same PR. That is the
# escape hatch, and unlike a label it leaves a permanent record of the decision.
.gitattributes
.gitignore
.gitmodules
.mcp.json
AGENTS.md
Cargo.lock
Cargo.toml
LICENSE
README.md
RULES.md
codecov.yml
dispatch_manifest.toml
feature_gate_exemptions.toml
requirements-cuda-dev.txt
roy_validate.sh
rust-toolchain.toml
